David Coulthard's first Grand Prix win from 2000 onward came in the 2000 season, when he won three races for McLaren (Monaco, French and British Grands Prix). In 2000, Ferrari won the constructors' championship with 170 points, ahead of McLaren on 162.

ANSWER: Ferrari
